[[File:Guard (cave goblin) chathead.png|left|80px]]
'''Guards''' are [[cave goblin]]s guards found in [[Dorgesh-Kaan]], guarding the entrance to the city and wandering around the city.

If a player fails to pickpocket a [[cave goblin|Dorgeshuun citizen]], a nearby guard will occasionally say "Stop that!" and attack.

They can be of some profit to players as their drops can be sold to the nearby [[Dorgeshuun]] store. These goblins can only be accessed after completing the [[Lost Tribe]] quest.
